title: Workflows component diagram
description: The three workflows GitHub runs on pull requests and the two scripts they call: what each calls, and what lies outside the folder. Nothing here deploys: the owner deploys each game from their own machine.

components.name: Workflows
components.responsibility: Tests and builds each game a pull request changes, and checks its database changes; deploys nothing.

components.name: CI (ci.yml)
components.responsibility: On every pull request: validates the .dev files and tests and builds each game the pull request changes.

components.name: Database migration (migrations.yml)
components.responsibility: The required pull request check: fails until a database change is acknowledged in the description.

components.name: Game (game.yml)
components.responsibility: One game's install, tests, build, the check that no .dev folder is in the build, and wrangler deploy when called with deploy true, which nothing does any more.

components.name: Changed games (changed-games.sh)
components.responsibility: Lists the games with a package.json that changed since a commit, leaving .dev files out.

components.name: Migration gate (migration-gate.sh)
components.responsibility: Finds database files changed since a commit and fails unless each change is acknowledged; the workflows run only its pr mode, and the zizd deploy step (.zazzle/zizd) its deploy mode, for one game.

components.name: Games
components.responsibility: The games the workflows test and build.

components.name: Validators (Meta/Agents)
components.responsibility: validate_diagrams.py and validate_knowledge.py, copied from human-assisted-software-development.

components.name: GitHub
components.responsibility: Runs the workflows on pull requests, and answers the gh calls for pull request descriptions.

components.name: Cloudflare
components.responsibility: Would receive a game's Worker and assets from game.yml's wrangler deploy step, which no workflow runs any more.
